title_en: Why Breeze Airways Is Taking Spirit Airlines' Leftover Leisure Markets But Avoiding Big Trunk Routes
title_zh: 为什么微风航空要占领精神航空剩余的休闲市场，但避开大型干线航线
summary: The carrier is making the most of the opportunities created by Spirit Airlines' demise.
summary_zh: 该航空公司正在充分利用精神航空倒闭所带来的机遇。
body_en: Journalist - Steven has a varied background in communications, and it was this passion for writing combined with his in-depth knowledge of the aviation industry that led him to Simple Flying. A keen linguist, he also has experience in translation and interpreting. Based in Palma, Spain

The collapse of Spirit Airlines in May has created opportunities across the US aviation market, leaving several airports without commercial service and removing an important source of low-cost competition on popular leisure routes. While other airlines have been cautious about taking over these abandoned markets, Breeze Airways is moving quickly.

It has been targeting destinations where passengers have lost convenient nonstop connections and where existing airline competition remains relatively limited. However, Breeze Airways is not attempting to recreate the network that Spirit Airlines once operated. Instead, its expansion reveals a much more selective strategy.

It is concentrating on smaller regional airports, holiday destinations, and point-to-point international services rather than competing directly on the country's busiest routes. From Latrobe, Pennsylvania, to Tampa, Florida, the airline is choosing opportunities that fit its operating model, suggesting that the most attractive parts of Spirit Airlines' former network are not necessarily its biggest routes.
Spirit Airlines' Collapse Has Created Opportunities For Breeze Airways

Spirit Airlines officially ceased operations on May 2, 2026 , following its unsuccessful attempts to reorganize under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and its subsequent move towards Chapter 7 liquidation. Rising fuel prices, which exceeded $4 per gallon amid geopolitical disruptions affecting energy markets, placed additional pressure on an already financially troubled business.

The deteriorating economics made its restructuring plans increasingly difficult to sustain. Its departure immediately created gaps in several markets where ultra-low-cost airlines had been the only commercial operator. Smaller airports were particularly exposed because they lacked the passenger volumes and competing airlines that could make replacing lost services relatively straightforward.

For communities accustomed to affordable nonstop flights, the shutdown meant losing more than an airline; it meant losing convenient access to important leisure destinations. Breeze Airways has identified these abandoned markets as potential opportunities, particularly where passengers previously depended on Spirit Airlines for direct holiday connections.

Rather than simply copying its former competitor's entire network, Breeze Airways is selecting individual routes that appear compatible with its aircraft, operating costs, and passenger demand. This distinction is important because not every route previously operated by Spirit Airlines necessarily offers attractive economics.

The airline's approach also reflects the competitive environment following Spirit Airlines' departure. Average fares have increased considerably on routes no longer served, demonstrating how the removal of an ultra-low-cost competitor can affect ticket prices. Breeze Airways therefore has an opportunity to attract price-conscious passengers without necessarily matching every fare previously offered by Spirit Airlines.
Latrobe Demonstrates The Appeal Of Smaller Airports

One of the clearest examples of this strategy is Arnold Palmer Regional Airport (LBE) in Latrobe, Pennsylvania. The airport lost all commercial passenger service when Spirit Airlines departed, leaving an important gap for residents of Westmoreland County and surrounding communities.

The consequences extended beyond passengers, with the airport also facing employment and economic challenges following the withdrawal of its only commercial airline. In the 12 months leading up to Spirit Airlines' collapse, data from the US Bureau of Transportation Statistics shows that the busiest three routes from the airport were those detailed in the table below.

Breeze Airways will restore scheduled commercial service with twice-weekly flights to Myrtle Beach International Airport (MYR) beginning February 9, 2027, followed by service to Orlando International Airport (MCO) from May 26, 2027. Both destinations appeal strongly to leisure travelers, offering straightforward connections to popular vacation markets.

Crucially, as well, they do not require passengers to travel through Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT) or another larger airport. The advertised introductory one-way fares make the routes particularly interesting. Myrtle Beach flights have been promoted from $49, while Orlando services start at $59. These prices position Breeze Airways competitively for families and travelers who previously relied on Spirit Airlines.

However, additional charges and changing availability mean the advertised starting fares will not represent every passenger's final ticket price. Latrobe also offers infrastructure advantages that make the opportunity more attractive. Its approximately $28 million terminal expansion introduced additional gate capacity and improved passenger facilities.

This created an airport environment capable of supporting renewed airline operations. With a relatively uncomplicated operating environment and limited direct competition, Breeze Airways can establish a presence without immediately entering the expensive competitive battles associated with major metropolitan airports.
Leisure Destinations Offer A More Natural Fit

Breeze Airways' selection of Myrtle Beach and Orlando illustrates why leisure markets are central to its expansion strategy. Both destinations attract substantial holiday demand, particularly from families and travelers planning trips around school holidays, seasonal breaks, and longer weekends. Their appeal is also relatively easy to communicate to passengers.

This makes them suitable destinations for an airline building awareness in previously underserved communities. Unlike large business-oriented markets, leisure routes can often be developed around concentrated periods of demand. Passengers traveling to Florida or South Carolina may be more willing to arrange their schedules around particular departure days.
body_zh: 记者 - 史蒂文在传播领域拥有不同的背景，正是这种对写作的热情与他对航空业的深入了解相结合，促使他创立了《简单飞行》。作为一位敏锐的语言学家，他还拥有翻译和口译经验。总部位于西班牙帕尔马
精神航空公司五月份的倒闭为整个美国航空市场创造了机会，导致多个机场失去商业服务，并消除了热门休闲航线上低成本竞争的一个重要来源。虽然其他航空公司对接管这些废弃的市场一直持谨慎态度，但微风航空正在迅速采取行动。
它一直瞄准乘客失去便利的直达航班且现有航空公司竞争仍然相对有限的目的地。然而，微风航空并没有试图重建精神航空曾经运营的网络。相反，它的扩张揭示了一种更具选择性的战略。
它专注于较小的支线机场、度假胜地和点对点国际服务，而不是直接在该国最繁忙的航线上竞争。从宾夕法尼亚州拉特罗布到佛罗里达州坦帕，该航空公司正在选择适合其运营模式的机会，这表明精神航空前网络中最具吸引力的部分不一定是其最大的航线。
精神航空的倒闭为微风航空创造了机会
精神航空在根据《美国破产法》第 11 章破产保护法尝试重组并随后根据《美国破产法》第 7 章进行清算但未获成功后，于 2026 年 5 月 2 日正式停止运营。由于地缘政治动荡影响能源市场，燃油价格上涨超过每加仑 4 美元，给本已陷入财务困境的企业带来了额外的压力。
不断恶化的经济状况使其重组计划越来越难以维持。它的退出立即在几个市场上造成了空白，在这些市场中，超低成本航空公司是唯一的商业运营商。较小的机场尤其容易受到影响，因为它们缺乏足够的客运量和竞争性的航空公司，无法相对简单地更换丢失的服务。
对于习惯了廉价直飞航班的社区来说，停飞意味着失去的不仅仅是一家航空公司；这意味着无法方便地前往重要的休闲目的地。微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 已将这些废弃市场视为潜在机遇，尤其是那些此前乘客依赖精神航空 (Spirit Airlines) 直接转机度假的市场。
微风航空并不是简单地复制其前竞争对手的整个网络，而是选择与其飞机、运营成本和乘客需求相匹配的单独航线。这种区别很重要，因为并非精神航空以前运营的每条航线都一定能提供有吸引力的经济效果。
该航空公司的做法也反映了精神航空退出后的竞争环境。不再提供服务的航线的平均票价大幅上涨，这表明超低成本竞争对手的消失会如何影响票价。因此，微风航空有机会吸引对价格敏感的乘客，而不必与精神航空之前提供的所有票价相匹配。
拉特罗布展示了小型机场的吸引力
这一战略最明显的例子之一是宾夕法尼亚州拉特罗布的阿诺德·帕尔默地区机场 (LBE)。精神航空起飞后，机场失去了所有商业客运服务，给威斯特摩兰县及周边社区的居民留下了重要的缺口。
其后果不仅限于乘客，在唯一一家商业航空公司退出后，机场还面临就业和经济挑战。在精神航空倒闭前的 12 个月里，美国运输统计局的数据显示，从该机场出发的最繁忙的 3 条航线如下表所示。
微风航空将从 2027 年 2 月 9 日起恢复飞往默特尔比奇国际机场 (MYR) 的定期商业航班，并于 2027 年 5 月 26 日起恢复飞往奥兰多国际机场 (MCO) 的航班。这两个目的地都对休闲旅客具有强烈的吸引力，可直接转乘热门度假市场。
同样重要的是，它们不需要乘客经过匹兹堡国际机场 (PIT) 或其他较大的机场。广告上介绍的单程票价让这些路线特别有趣。默特尔比奇航班起价为 49 美元，奥兰多航班起价为 59 美元。这些价格使微风航空对于以前依赖精神航空的家庭和旅客来说具有竞争力。
然而，额外费用和不断变化的供应情况意味着广告中的起始票价并不代表每位乘客的最终票价。拉特罗布还提供基础设施优势，使机会更具吸引力。其耗资约 2800 万美元的航站楼扩建增加了登机口容量并改善了客运设施。
这创造了一个能够支持新的航空公司运营的机场环境。凭借相对简单的运营环境和有限的直接竞争，微风航空可以在不立即参与与主要城市机场相关的昂贵竞争的情况下建立业务。
休闲目的地提供更自然的体验
微风航空选择默特尔比奇和奥兰多说明了为什么休闲市场是其扩张战略的核心。这两个目的地都吸引了大量的度假需求，尤其是计划在学校假期、季节性假期和较长周末期间旅行的家庭和旅行者。它们的吸引力也相对容易向乘客传达。
这使得它们成为航空公司在以前服务不足的社区建立意识的合适目的地。与大型商业市场不同，休闲路线往往可以围绕需求集中期开发。前往佛罗里达州或南卡罗来纳州的乘客可能更愿意在特定的出发日期安排行程。

title_en: How To Tell Different Airplanes Apart, From 737s To A380s: An AvGeek’s Guide
title_zh: 如何区分从 737 到 A380 的不同飞机：AvGeek 指南
summary: Plenty of frequent flyers can't tell an A380 from a 747. Here's how I identify Boeing and Airbus planes in a split second, from winglets to doors and wheels.
summary_zh: 许多经常乘坐飞机的人无法区分 A380 和 747。以下是我如何瞬间识别波音和空客飞机的方法，从机翼到机门，以及
body_en: The miles & points world has all kinds of different enthusiasts — some people are only interested in miles & points in order to save money on travel, while others are interested in miles & points because they love airplanes . I know there are plenty of people who are very frequent flyers but can barely tell the difference between an Airbus A380 and Boeing 747.

In this post, I’d like to share how I easily identify planes in a split second. Of course there are lots of methods for doing this, but I’ll share my techniques (and maybe other hardcore avgeeks can chime in with their methods in the comments section).

To keep things simple, I’ll just stick to the most popular mainline, commercial aircraft, and I’ll be talking about each “family” of aircraft in a particular section. Let’s start with Boeing aircraft, and then we’ll cover Airbus aircraft.
The Boeing 737 is the most common commercial aircraft in service. To me, there are a couple most obvious signs that a plane is a 737, as opposed to an A220 or A320.

One method is to look at the cockpit windows. The 737 has six cockpit windows (which is standard), and the window at the far end on each side “slopes up” at the bottom, so the window doesn’t go as far down as on other jets. Furthermore, when you look at the tail of the 737, you’ll see that it connects with the rest of the plane with an extended slope, much more so than on the A220 or A320 (below you can see a 737 in the front and an A321 in the back).

What can make identifying the 737 challenging is that there are so many different variants. Let’s differentiate between the 737 NG (the older version of the jet), and the 737 MAX (the newer and more controversial version of the jet).

There are three most obvious ways to tell if you’re traveling on a 737 MAX. The 737 MAX has the zig-zag pattern at the back of the engines, which I’ll talk more about below, as you’ll also find this on 787s and 747-8s.

Furthermore, the 737 MAX has the split winglet, which is large going both up and down, and the edges remain flat and straight. While some 737 NGs have split scimitar winglets, the upper and lower edges of the winglet are sloped.
Lastly, the 737 MAX has perfectly round engines, while the 737 NG engines flatten out a bit at the bottom, or look more oval.

How can you tell the difference between the variants? In terms of fuselage design, there’s the 737-700, 737-800/737 MAX 8, and 737-900/737 MAX 9 (with the 737 MAX 7 and 737 MAX 10 entering service soon). The 737-700 is the smallest variant, and the easiest way to identify it is based on the single exit on each side over the wing.

The 737-800 and 737 MAX 8 have two exits over the wing on each side, in addition to the exits at the front and back of the aircraft. The only exception would be the 737 MAX 8200, which is operated by some ultra low cost carriers, where there’s an extra exit in the back, with nine windows behind it.

Then the 737-900 and 737 MAX 9 have two exits over the wing, plus they have an additional door plug (as opposed to an actual exit) between the wing and rear exit, which is why the window spacing is a little weird in the back.
While Boeing’s modern narrow body aircraft is the 737, there are still a fair number of 757s flying around. The 757 is sort of like a flying pencil, as it’s quite long and the fuselage is narrow.

Unlike most other narrow body planes, the 757 has 10 wheels, as it has two wheels in the front, and two sets of four wheels in the back, which differentiates it from the 737, A320, etc., as those planes typically only have six wheels. The 757 also has a “proper” exit door behind the forward section, plus two overwing exits.
There are two variants of the 757 — the 757-200 and 757-300. The way to tell them apart is easy. The 757-200 does not typically have an additional exit between the overwing exits and the rear door.

Meanwhile the 757-300 does have another full exit in the rear section, with roughly a dozen windows on each side between it and the rear door. The 757-300 looks so long that you’d think it would break in half (don’t worry, it won’t).

As far as I’m concerned, the Boeing 747 will always be the queen of the skies. While the Airbus A380 has overtaken it in terms of size and passenger comfort, it can’t compete with the 747’s curves. The 747 has a full lower deck and then a partial upper deck, making it easy to identify.
While the passenger version of the 747 is becoming increasingly rare nowadays, there are two types that are most common — the 747-400 and the 747-8 (and no, it’s not the 747-800).

How can you tell the difference between the two planes? For one, the 747-400 has traditional winglets that stick “up.” On top of that, the 747-400 has a smaller upper deck. Behind the upper deck exit row, there are only seven windows on each side.
As a point of comparison, the 747-8’s wingtips gradually go up, and the upper deck is bigger, with 15 windows on each side behind the upper deck exit row.
body_zh: 里程和积分的世界里有各种各样不同的爱好者——有些人对里程和积分感兴趣只是为了在旅行时省钱，而另一些人对里程和积分感兴趣是因为他们喜欢飞机。我知道有很多人经常乘坐飞机，但几乎无法区分空客 A380 和波音 747 之间的区别。
在这篇文章中，我想分享如何在瞬间轻松识别飞机。当然，有很多方法可以做到这一点，但我将分享我的技术（也许其他铁杆爱好者可以在评论部分加入他们的方法）。
为了简单起见，我将只讨论最受欢迎的干线商用飞机，并且我将在特定部分讨论每个“系列”飞机。让我们从波音飞机开始，然后我们将介绍空中客车飞机。
波音 737 是现役最常见的商用飞机。对我来说，有几个最明显的迹象表明这架飞机是 737，而不是 A220 或 A320。
一种方法是查看驾驶舱窗户。 737 有六个驾驶舱窗户（这是标准配置），每侧远端的窗户在底部“向上倾斜”，因此窗户不会像其他喷气式飞机那样向下倾斜。此外，当您观察 737 的尾部时，您会发现它以延伸的斜度与飞机的其余部分连接，比 A220 或 A320 的斜度要大得多（下面您可以看到前面是 737，后面是 A321）。
识别 737 具有挑战性的是，它有太多不同的型号。让我们区分一下 737 NG（较旧版本的喷气式飞机）和 737 MAX（较新且更具争议的喷气式飞机版本）。
有三种最明显的方法可以判断您是否乘坐 737 MAX 旅行。 737 MAX 的发动机后部有锯齿形图案，我将在下面详细讨论，因为您也会在 787 和 747-8 上找到这种图案。
此外，737 MAX 具有分体式小翼，向上和向下都很大，边缘保持平直。虽然某些 737 NG 具有分裂式弯刀小翼，但小翼的上边缘和下边缘是倾斜的。
最后，737 MAX 拥有完美的圆形发动机，而 737 NG 发动机底部有点扁平，或者看起来更椭圆形。
您如何区分变体之间的差异？机身设计方面，有737-700、737-800/737 MAX 8和737-900/737 MAX 9（737 MAX 7和737 MAX 10即将投入使用）。 737-700 是最小的型号，识别它的最简单方法是根据机翼两侧的单个出口。
除了飞机前后的出口外，737-800 和 737 MAX 8 在机翼两侧各有两个出口。唯一的例外是 737 MAX 8200，它由一些超低成本航空公司运营，后面有一个额外的出口，后面有九个窗户。
然后，737-900 和 737 MAX 9 在机翼上方有两个出口，此外，它们在机翼和后部出口之间还有一个额外的门塞（而不是实际的出口），这就是为什么后面的窗户间距有点奇怪。
虽然波音公司的现代窄体飞机是 737，但仍有相当数量的 757 飞机在飞行。 757 有点像一支飞铅笔，因为它很长，机身很窄。
与大多数其他窄体飞机不同，757 有 10 个轮子，因为它前面有两个轮子，后面有两组四个轮子，这与 737、A320 等飞机通常只有六个轮子不同。 757 在前部后面还有一个“适当的”出口门，以及两个机翼上方的出口。
757 有两种型号：757-200 和 757-300。区分它们的方法很简单。 757-200 通常在机翼上方出口和后门之间没有额外的出口。
与此同时，757-300 的后部确实有另一个完整的出口，在它和后门之间的每一侧都有大约十几个窗户。 757-300 看起来太长了，您可能会认为它会断成两半（别担心，它不会断）。
在我看来，波音 747 永远是空中女王。虽然空客 A380 在尺寸和乘客舒适度方面已经超越了它，但它无法与 747 的曲线竞争。 747 拥有完整的下层甲板和部分上层甲板，因此易于识别。
虽然 747 的客运版本如今变得越来越罕见，但有两种最常见的类型 - 747-400 和 747-8（不，它不是 747-800）。
你如何区分两架飞机？其一，747-400 拥有“向上”伸出的传统小翼。除此之外，747-400 的上层甲板较小。在上层甲板出口排后面，每侧只有七个窗户。
作为对比，747-8的翼尖逐渐上升，上层甲板更大，上层出口排后面每侧有15扇窗户。

summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 12 日，从阿姆斯特丹史基浦起飞的英国航空 BA431 航班在伦敦希思罗机场降落时尾部撞击后复飞。
body_en: British Airways A321neo goes around after Heathrow tailstrike - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) British Airways A321neo goes around after Heathrow tailstrike

British Airways flight BA431 from Amsterdam Schiphol went around after a tailstrike during landing at London Heathrow on 12 November 2026. The Airbus A321neo, registered G-TNEB, landed safely on its second approach about 14 minutes later. No injuries were reported.

The incident occurred at about 10:35 local time on runway 27L. Footage from two airport cameras appears to show the aircraft bouncing on touchdown and its tail contacting the runway twice before the crew climbed away. The Aviation Safety Network recorded a tailstrike during touchdown and listed the extent of the damage as unknown.
British Airways took the aircraft out of service for inspection and said it was assisting the UK Air Accidents Investigation Branch (AAIB) with its investigation.

The cause of the bounced landing remains undetermined. Heathrow’s 10:20 weather observation, about 15 minutes before the incident, recorded light rain, an overcast cloud base at 1,400 feet and a south-southeasterly wind at 11 knots.

事件发生在当地时间上午10时35分左右，地点为27L跑道。两个机场摄像机的镜头似乎显示，飞机在接地时弹起，机尾两次接触跑道，然后机组人员爬离。航空安全网络记录了着陆期间发生的尾部撞击事件，并将损坏程度列为未知。
英国航空公司已将这架飞机停飞接受检查，并表示正在协助英国航空事故调查处（AAIB）进行调查。
弹跳着陆的原因尚未确定。事发前约 15 分钟，希思罗机场 10 点 20 分的天气观测记录到有小雨，云底高度为 1,400 英尺阴，风速为 11 节/小时。

Home Manufacturers Sikorsky Four killed in Turkish military helicopter crash near Malatya
A Turkish military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crashed on the southern outskirts of Malatya on Thursday evening, 12 November, killing four military personnel on board, the Turkish Defence Ministry said.

The helicopter came down near a cluster of buildings in the Samanköy neighbourhood. Police, firefighters and medical teams were sent to the scene. The Demirören News Agency reported that fire from the wreckage spread to a nearby house, with no casualties reported on the ground.
The Defence Ministry said the cause of the crash had yet to be determined.

body_en: IATA warns only half of air accident probes yield public final reports - Aviation24.be
Home Miscellaneous Accidents IATA warns only half of air accident probes yield public final reports
IATA - International Air Transport Association

Only about half of aviation accidents investigated under international rules result in a published final report, according to Mark Searle, IATA’s global director of safety. Speaking to Reuters at the International Aviation Safety Summit in Montreal on 12 November, Searle said publication rates had shown little improvement, limiting the industry’s ability to learn from accidents and act on safety recommendations.

Under ICAO’s Annex 13 framework, investigators should publish a final report as soon as possible and, if possible, within 12 months. If the report is still pending, the investigating authority should publish an interim statement on each anniversary of the accident, outlining progress and any safety issues identified. The purpose of the investigation is to prevent future accidents.

A joint industry paper published in February 2025 gives a historical benchmark. IATA data showed that investigations had been completed for 140 of the 268 accidents recorded from 2018 to 2023, or 52%, as of 30 June 2024. Hassan Shahidi, president of the Flight Safety Foundation, told Reuters that investigating agencies often cite shortages of suitably qualified staff.

Reuters cited two high-profile cases still awaiting final reports as of 12 November: the June 2025 crash of an Air India Boeing 787 shortly after take-off from Ahmedabad, which killed 260 people, and the 2022 China Eastern Airlines crash.
Sources: Reuters , Joint industry position paper , IATA

首页 其他事故 国际航空运输协会警告说，只有一半的航空事故调查得出公开的最终报告
IATA-国际航空运输协会
国际航空运输协会全球安全总监马克·塞尔表示，根据国际规则调查的航空事故中，只有大约一半会发布最终报告。 11 月 12 日，塞尔在蒙特利尔举行的国际航空安全峰会上向路透社表示，发表率几乎没有改善，限制了该行业从事故中吸取教训并根据安全建议采取行动的能力。
根据国际民航组织附件 13 框架，调查人员应尽快发布最终报告，如有可能，应在 12 个月内发布。如果报告仍在等待中，调查当局应在事故周年纪念日发布一份临时声明，概述进展情况和发现的任何安全问题。调查的目的是为了防止未来发生事故。
2025 年 2 月发表的一份行业联合论文给出了历史基准。国际航空运输协会的数据显示，截至 2024 年 6 月 30 日，2018 年至 2023 年记录的 268 起事故中，有 140 起事故的调查已完成，即 52%。飞行安全基金会主席哈桑·沙希迪 (Hassan Shahidi) 告诉路透社，调查机构经常指出缺乏合格的工作人员。
路透社援引了截至 11 月 12 日仍在等待最终报告的两起备受瞩目的案件：2025 年 6 月印度航空一架波音 787 从艾哈迈达巴德起飞后不久坠毁，造成 260 人死亡，以及 2022 年中国东方航空坠机事故。
资料来源：路透社、联合行业立场文件、国际航空运输协会

body_en: FAA lifts US ground stop. Belgian flight impacts remain unconfirmed - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Brussels Airport (BRU) FAA lifts US ground stop. Belgian flight impacts remain unconfirmed

The FAA lifted its nationwide ground stop by 02:25 CET (UTC+1) on Saturday 14 November 2026, allowing US departures to resume. Airlines were still recovering from the air traffic control communications outage, with aircraft and crews out of position.
Thousands of travellers across the United States were stranded after a ground stop that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed on faltering, ageing infrastructure.

More than 3,200 flights had already been cancelled across the United States by 08:30 EST (UTC-5) on Saturday, 14 November, as airlines worked to recover from Friday’s nationwide ground stop. The cancellations accounted for more than 14% of Saturday’s scheduled flights, according to aviation data firm Cirium.

On Friday, more than 8,200 flights were cancelled, representing over 31% of the day’s schedule. The Federal Aviation Administration halted departures for several hours after an air traffic control communications problem. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy attributed the disruption to ageing infrastructure.
The disruption also affected transatlantic services. By around 10:00 GMT on Saturday, FlightAware had recorded 19 cancellations and 22 delays on flights between London Heathrow and the United States.

Hundreds of passengers crowded into Terminal 1 at Chicago O’Hare on Saturday morning, many returning after Friday’s cancellations. At Los Angeles International Airport, some stranded travellers were still looking for replacement flights and overnight accommodation.

The FAA decision lifts the nationwide hold on departures from the US. We did not find separate confirmation that EUROCONTROL ended its restriction on US-bound departures before the previously reported 06:00 Belgian time . Belgian passenger and cargo cancellation and delay totals remain unconfirmed, as does the status of Challenge Airlines BE’s 05:15 Liège–New York JFK freighter.
Brussels–Chicago flight cancelled after overnight US air traffic restrictions

Brussels Airport (BRU), Saturday 14 November. United Airlines flight UA973 to Chicago O’Hare, scheduled for 10:10 CET , was listed as cancelled by Plane Finder, Flightera and Trip.com. United has yet to confirm the cause publicly.

EUROCONTROL removed its notice suspending US-bound departures on Saturday morning, dpa reported. The published restriction ran from 23:00 CET on Friday 13 November to 06:00 CET on Saturday 14 November . The wider impact on Belgian passenger and cargo flights remains unquantified.
For Aviation24.be, this is the first corroborated Brussels passenger cancellation identified in the morning follow-up. Whether it was a knock-on effect of the US outage remains unconfirmed.
Brussels–Chicago disruption update: inbound flight also cancelled

Brussels Airport (BRU), Saturday 14 November. United Airlines flight UA972 from Chicago O’Hare was also cancelled, according to FlightStats, AirNav Radar and Aviability. It was due to leave Chicago at 00:50 CET and arrive in Brussels at 08:55 CET . The 10:10 CET Brussels–Chicago service, UA973 , was reported cancelled in the earlier alert.

body_zh: 美国联邦航空局取消美国地面停留。比利时航班的影响尚未得到证实 - Aviation24.be
主页 机场 布鲁塞尔机场 (BRU) 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 取消美国地面停靠站。比利时航班的影响尚未得到证实
美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 于 2026 年 11 月 14 日星期六欧洲中部时间 02:25 (UTC+1) 取消了全国范围内的地面停留，允许美国航班恢复。航空公司仍在从空中交通管制通信中断中恢复，飞机和机组人员都处于失控状态。
美国各地数千名旅客在一次地面停留后被困，交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 将此归咎于摇摇欲坠、老化的基础设施。
截至 11 月 14 日星期六美国东部时间 08:30 (UTC-5)，全美各地已有 3,200 多个航班被取消，航空公司正努力从周五的全国地面停靠中恢复过来。根据航空数据公司 Cirium 的数据，取消的航班占周六定期航班的 14% 以上。
周五，超过 8,200 架航班被取消，占当天航班计划的 31% 以上。空中交通管制通信出现问题后，美国联邦航空管理局暂停了航班起飞几个小时。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲将此次破坏归咎于基础设施老化。
此次中断还影响了跨大西洋服务。截至格林威治标准时间周六 10:00 左右，FlightAware 记录了伦敦希思罗机场和美国之间的航班有 19 次取消和 22 次延误。
周六早上，数百名乘客涌入芝加哥奥黑尔机场 1 号航站楼，其中许多人在周五航班取消后返回。在洛杉矶国际机场，一些滞留的旅客仍在寻找替代航班和过夜住宿。
美国联邦航空局的决定解除了全国范围内对从美国出发的航班的限制。我们没有找到单独的确认信息，表明 EUROCONTROL 在之前报道的比利时时间 06:00 之前结束了对前往美国的航班的限制。比利时客运和货运取消和延误总数尚未得到证实，挑战航空公司 BE 05:15 列日 - 纽约肯尼迪货机的状态也尚未得到证实。
美国隔夜空中交通限制后布鲁塞尔-芝加哥航班取消
布鲁塞尔机场 (BRU)，11 月 14 日星期六。联合航空 UA973 航班原定于欧洲中部时间 10:10 飞往芝加哥奥黑尔，但 Plane Finder、Flightera 和 Trip.com 均将其列为取消航班。曼联尚未公开确认原因。
据德新社报道，欧洲空中航行安全组织 (EUROCONTROL) 于周六上午取消了暂停飞往美国航班的通知。公布的限制时间为欧洲中部时间 11 月 13 日星期五 23:00 至 11 月 14 日星期六欧洲中部时间 06:00。对比利时客运和货运航班的更广泛影响仍无法量化。
对于 Aviation24.be 来说，这是在上午的后续行动中发现的首例经证实的布鲁塞尔乘客取消航班。这是否是美国停电的连锁反应尚未得到证实。
布鲁塞尔-芝加哥航班中断更新：入境航班也取消
布鲁塞尔机场 (BRU)，11 月 14 日星期六。根据 FlightStats、AirNav Radar 和 Aviability 的数据，联合航空从芝加哥奥黑尔起飞的 UA972 航班也被取消。航班原定于欧洲中部时间 00:50 离开芝加哥，并于欧洲中部时间 08:55 抵达布鲁塞尔。据报道，欧洲中部时间 10:10 布鲁塞尔至芝加哥航班 UA973 已在早些时候的警报中取消。

EUROCONTROL suspended US-bound departures from its member states at the FAA’s request after a US air traffic control communications outage . The announced window ran from 23:00 on Friday 13 November to 06:00 on Saturday 14 November 2026, Belgian time (UTC+1).

Belgian impact. The restriction covered US-bound passenger and cargo departures from Brussels Airport (BRU) and US-bound freighters from Liège (LGG) . Challenge Airlines BE’s FRH591 to New York JFK was listed for 05:15 CET , within the announced window. Its operating status and any Belgian cancellation or delay totals remain unconfirmed.
